title: My phone showed me tomorrow 📱
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 3:33 in the morning, my phone showed me a memory from tomorrow.

scenes.narration: At 3:33 in the morning, my phone showed me a memory from tomorrow.
A notification. On this day. One new memory. I thought it was a glitch. I opened it.
A photo of my kitchen. Lights off. I was standing at the table, drinking water in the dark.
The timestamp said tomorrow, 3:35 in the morning. I was in bed. The kitchen was down the hall.
I swiped. Another photo. My bed. Me, sitting up, holding my phone. Looking at the screen. Right now.
The edges of the photo were wrong. Two thin lines of dark on either side. As if it was taken through a gap.
I looked at my wardrobe. The door was shut. I looked at my phone. It was 3:34.
The next photo was the hallway. Then the stairs. Then my front door, wide open. Each one a little later than the last.
The last photo had no timestamp. Only a caption. Delete this before it happens.
That is when I understood where the camera was. Inside the wardrobe. Looking out at me. And the door was already open.
So tell me. Do you look in the wardrobe, or delete the photo?
